phase: 0 (no training): G1 cross-scale inconsistency vs FR test D_s, G2 geometric self-ensemble

scale_b.description: Wald degradation by 2 of the validation scale-A patches; PAN/MS ratio stays 4
scale_b.mtf: DLPan genMTF formula (as common/observation.py) with ratio 2, 41 taps, Kaiser radial window, signed taps kept

G1.primary_metric: I_cs = mean over patches of MSE(D(f(x_A)), f(x_B)) on the scale-B interior
G1.target: FR test 20-scene mean D_s from each model's archived evaluation
G1.primary_set: the same 15 models as SSAI 11 D7
G1.extended_set: primary set plus 15 more archived models with FR test results

gate.pass: Spearman(I_cs, D_s) >= 0.7 on the primary set AND >= 0.5 on primary+extended
gate.fail: otherwise; do not train the consistency regularizer, use plan B (detail-injection constrained output)

G1.reference: SSAI 11 D7 reduced-scale FR proxy: Spearman -0.18 on the same 15 models

G2.method: average of 8 dihedral transforms (rot90 x4, horizontal flip x2) on PAN, LMS, MS; inverse transform of outputs
G2.report: difference from the single forward of the same weights
G2.note: inference-only protocol; reported separately, never mixed with single-forward results
G2.useful_if: A0 PSNR >= +0.05 dB and provisional QNR not worse

arms: W+S: W2 + scale-B supervision + cross-scale consistency
planned_phase1_if_pass.condition: QB seed42, FP32, batch32, Adam 1e-4 constant, 100 epochs
planned_phase1_if_pass.loss: MSE(f(x_A),GT_A) + lambda_B MSE(f(x_B),GT_B) + lambda_c ||D(f(x_A)) - f(x_B)||^2; lambdas fixed from initial gradient ratios

decision.improvement_WS_vs_A0: PSNR >= +0.3 dB, SAM <= -0.1 deg, QNR >= +0.005, D_s worse by at most 0.003
